atlas_research_hypothesis.query: Formulate an empirical multi-timeframe trading hypothesis for USDJPY (SWING_TRADING). Observed microstructure physics: personality=STOP_HUNT_MEAN_REVERTING, wick_to_body=3.453, trend_persistence=0.27, mean_reversion=0.73. Learned timeframe weights: W1 (w=+0.271), H4 (w=+0.271), H1 (w=+0.271). Ablation-retained features: liquidity_sweep (w=+0.259), fvg_impulse (w=+0.203), rsi_momentum (w=+0.141), ema_trend (w=+0.139) (pruned/left out by ablation: none).
atlas_research_hypothesis.hypothesis_statement: Atlas & Forge empirical synthesis for USDJPY (SWING_TRADING): Data shows STOP_HUNT_MEAN_REVERTING microstructure (wick/body=3.453, mean-reversion=0.73). Multi-timeframe return regression assigns highest predictive weight to W1 (w=+0.271), H4 (w=+0.271), H1 (w=+0.271). Controlled leave-one-out ablation retained [liquidity_sweep (w=+0.259), fvg_impulse (w=+0.203), rsi_momentum (w=+0.141), ema_trend (w=+0.139)] and pruned [none].
